passage.label: Noah said My Lord indeed disobeyed me followed him whose wealth children not increase except loss; conspired immense conspiracy; said never leave gods never leave Wadd Suwa Yaghuth Yauq Nasr; already misled many do not increase wrongdoers except error; because sins drowned put into Fire found not besides Allah helpers; Noah said My Lord do not leave upon earth disbelievers inhabitant; indeed if leave them mislead Your servants not beget except wicked confirmed disbeliever; My Lord forgive me parents whoever enters house believer believing men believing women do not increase wrongdoers except destruction

arabicExcerpts.text: قَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا
وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدّٗا وَلَا سُوَاعٗا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرٗا
وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرٗاۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلٗا
مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارٗا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارٗا
وَقَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرٗا كَفَّارٗا
رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا

mainSubject.label: Noah reporting that his people disobeyed him and followed one whose wealth and children only increased his loss; their immense conspiracy expressed in the command never to abandon their gods — Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Ya'uq and Nasr — having already misled many, prompting his plea that the wrongdoers be increased only in error; because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire finding no helpers besides Allah; his further plea that no disbelieving inhabitant be left on earth since they would mislead His servants and beget only the wicked and confirmed disbelievers; closing with the taught supplication for forgiveness of himself, his parents, whoever enters his house as a believer and all believing men and women, while asking that the wrongdoers be increased only in destruction

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the undelayable appointed term (4) before Noah's night-and-day complaint opens (5); P2 ends with the earth-as-expanse and roads-of-passage argument (20) before the disobedience-and-conspiracy report begins (21); P3 runs through the five named idols, the drowning verdict, the no-inhabitant plea and the closing comprehensive supplication (21-28).
